description.value: Elma is a Turkish-inspired waterfront restaurant on Lake Okanagan in Penticton, owned and operated by Michael and Ayse Barluk, blending traditional Turkish culinary techniques with local Okanagan ingredients and imported Turkish décor. The shareable-plate menu evolves seasonally, and the restaurant runs an immersive Regional Dinner Series exploring distinct culinary regions of Türkiye. A second-floor event space with lake views is available for private bookings.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at eatatelma.com is fully accessible and confirms an active, operating restaurant at 994 Lakeshore Drive West, Penticton with phone 1.236.422.3562 — consistent with the OSM address. The menu page explicitly lists vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, dairy-free, and nut-free dietary labels on individual dishes, providing strong positive evidence for that amenity. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere in the fetched content, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone 1.236.422.3562 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant on the Penticton waterfront with a confirmed website and current events. Useful to touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal.
